name: Ruru
source:
A very firm...seeming person, but really a ditz. A natural mediator. Tends to drop her wallet a lot, no matter how much she tries to hold onto it.

A warm-hearted onee-san. Likes to take care of others.

Likes: Canned mandarin oranges, cats, baths, women's magazines (Like Josei S●ven or Josei ●mi...)

Dislikes: Coins with holes in them (5 yen and 50 yen coins), fizzy drinks (she can't drink them), complex electrical appliances (doesn't understand them, they don't seem to like her either)
